La formation a couvert l’isolement microbien, le contrôle qualité, la biosécurité, la production de cultures et l’application en serre et au champ afin de renforcer l’expertise locale et la gestion durable des nutriments.

ar.title: سيشل تعزز قدراتها على تطوير أسمدة حيوية ملائمة للظروف المحلية
ar.summary: يفيد قسم الزراعة في سيشل بأن تدريباً لمدة خمسة أيام حول تطوير الأسمدة الحيوية نُظم ضمن مشروع التعاون التقني SEY5013 التابع للوكالة الدولية للطاقة الذرية. وشمل التدريب عزل الميكروبات ومراقبة الجودة والسلامة الحيوية وإنتاج المزارع الميكروبية وطرق التطبيق في البيوت المحمية والحقول بهدف تعزيز الخبرة المحلية والإدارة المستدامة للمغذيات.

pt.title: Seicheles reforça capacidade para desenvolver biofertilizantes adaptados às condições locais
pt.summary: O Departamento de Agricultura das Seicheles informa que foi realizada uma formação de cinco dias sobre desenvolvimento de biofertilizantes no âmbito do projeto de cooperação técnica SEY5013 da AIEA. A formação abrangeu isolamento microbiano, controlo de qualidade, biossegurança, produção de culturas e aplicação em estufa e no campo, com o objetivo de reforçar a competência local e a gestão sustentável de nutrientes.

sw.title: Seychelles yaimarisha uwezo wa kutengeneza biofertilizer zinazofaa mazingira ya eneo hilo
sw.summary: Idara ya Kilimo ya Seychelles inaripoti kuwa mafunzo ya siku tano kuhusu uundaji wa biofertilizer yalifanyika chini ya mradi wa ushirikiano wa kiufundi wa IAEA SEY5013. Mafunzo yalijumuisha kutenga vijidudu, udhibiti wa ubora, usalama wa viumbe, uzalishaji wa tamaduni na matumizi kwenye greenhouses na mashambani ili kuimarisha utaalamu wa ndani na usimamizi endelevu wa virutubisho.

records.title: Libya and Djibouti discuss cooperation in livestock production and agricultural investment
records.summary: The Libyan News Agency reports that Libya’s agriculture and animal-resources delegation held talks in Djibouti on technical cooperation, pasture development, livestock production and agricultural investment. The discussion concerns potential cooperation and investment opportunities, not confirmed funding or an open grant application.

fr.title: La Libye et Djibouti discutent de coopération dans l’élevage et l’investissement agricole
fr.summary: L’agence de presse libyenne rapporte que la délégation libyenne chargée de l’agriculture et des ressources animales a discuté à Djibouti de coopération technique, de développement des pâturages, de production animale et d’investissement agricole. Il s’agit de possibilités de coopération, et non d’un financement confirmé ou d’un appel à subventions ouvert.

ar.title: ليبيا وجيبوتي تبحثان التعاون في الإنتاج الحيواني والاستثمار الزراعي
ar.summary: تفيد وكالة الأنباء الليبية بأن وفد وزارة الزراعة والموارد الحيوانية الليبية بحث في جيبوتي التعاون الفني وتنمية المراعي والإنتاج الحيواني والاستثمار الزراعي. ويتعلق النقاش بفرص تعاون واستثمار محتملة، وليس بتمويل مؤكد أو طلب منحة مفتوح.

pt.title: Líbia e Djibuti discutem cooperação na produção pecuária e no investimento agrícola
pt.summary: A Agência de Notícias da Líbia informa que uma delegação líbia da agricultura e dos recursos animais discutiu no Djibuti a cooperação técnica, o desenvolvimento de pastagens, a produção pecuária e o investimento agrícola. A notícia refere oportunidades potenciais, não financiamento confirmado nem candidaturas abertas a subsídios.

sw.title: Libya na Djibouti zajadili ushirikiano katika ufugaji na uwekezaji wa kilimo
sw.summary: Shirika la Habari la Libya linaripoti kuwa ujumbe wa Libya wa kilimo na rasilimali za mifugo ulijadiliana Djibouti kuhusu ushirikiano wa kiufundi, maendeleo ya malisho, uzalishaji wa mifugo na uwekezaji wa kilimo. Mazungumzo yanahusu fursa zinazowezekana, si ufadhili uliothibitishwa au maombi ya ruzuku yaliyo wazi.

records.title: Djibouti reviews livestock quarantine and export safeguards at Damerjog centre
records.summary: Djibouti’s agriculture minister visited the Damerjog livestock quarantine and export centre to review veterinary laboratories, animal-health controls and procedures for livestock destined for export. The visit highlighted the role of coordinated veterinary inspection in protecting animal and public health and supporting regional livestock trade.

records.title: Eritrea trains farmers in small, productive farm-plot methods
records.summary: Eritrea’s Ministry of Information reports that farmers in Teseney received practical and classroom training on small productive farm plots. Agricultural experts highlighted water and soil conservation, organic fertiliser, improved seeds, and opportunities to expand fruit, vegetable, poultry and dairy production.

records.title: Assaba regional committee reviews Mauritania’s 2026 agropastoral season and food security
records.summary: Mauritania’s national news agency reports that Assaba’s regional food and nutrition security committee reviewed rainfall, farming and pastoral conditions, market food availability and prices, nutrition vulnerability, and the response to the lean season. This is a regional monitoring update, not a new grant announcement.

records.title: Congo’s 2026 agricultural fair showcases livestock and expanding local production
records.summary: Les Dépêches de Brazzaville reports that livestock was a major feature of the second Grande Foire Agricole du Congo, with cattle, small ruminants, pigs and poultry presented by entrepreneurs. The event highlighted opportunities and challenges for increasing domestic meat production and reducing dependence on imports.

records.title: São Tomé and Príncipe launches a family-farming support fund with GTI Bank
records.summary: STP-Press reports that the government launched the Fundo de Apoio à Agricultura Familiar and signed an agreement with GTI Bank to support its financial operations. The fund is intended to promote sustainable family farming; farmers should confirm eligibility, terms and application procedures with the responsible ministry or bank before relying on the announcement.

records.title: Togo outlines seed and fertiliser support for the 2026 farming campaign
records.summary: The Togolese government says the 2026 agricultural campaign plans to make 3,809 tonnes of food-crop seed and 85,000 tonnes of fertiliser available to producers. The programme focuses on staple crops including maize, sorghum, millet, cassava, yam, sweet potato, cowpea and groundnut; farmers should check current local distribution arrangements with agricultural services.
records.source: Republic of Togo government information portal

records.title: Mozambique launches AgriConnect to strengthen agribusiness and agricultural value chains
records.summary: Mozambique’s Ministry of Agriculture, Environment and Fisheries announced AgriConnect to support agribusiness, employment for women and young people, and food security. Priority value chains include banana, sugar, cotton and cashew, alongside rice, maize, beans and tilapia, aiming to reduce import dependence and create rural jobs.
records.source: Mozambique Ministry of Agriculture, Environment and Fisheries (MAAP)

records.title: Tahoua onion value chain brings Nigerien producers and market actors together
records.summary: Niger’s national press agency reports that a public-private workshop convened onion value-chain actors from all eight regions to identify barriers and opportunities in seed and input access, finance, storage, markets and producer organisation. The initiative aims to improve competitiveness, market access and income for onion growers.

records.title: Seychelles strengthens recovery and recycling of lost fishing gear
records.summary: Seychelles News Agency reports that a Japan-funded regional project involving Seychelles, Mauritius, Madagascar and Comoros has entered its final phase. Implemented with FAO support, the initiative aims to recover, recycle and improve management of abandoned or lost fishing gear and end-of-life equipment, reducing marine pollution and supporting sustainable fisheries.

records.title: Mozambique food insecurity expected to worsen during the October 2026–March 2027 lean season
records.summary: The IPC analysis estimates 1.19 million people in 46 districts faced Crisis-level or worse acute food insecurity in July–September 2026, with 1.84 million projected to face these conditions from October 2026 to March 2027. Flooding, cyclone damage, conflict-related displacement, high prices and El Niño-related climate risks are among the reported drivers.
records.editorial_note: Use as a food-security and agricultural-livelihoods update; figures are estimates/projections from the IPC analysis and should retain their stated time periods.

fr.title: L’insécurité alimentaire au Mozambique devrait s’aggraver pendant la période de soudure d’octobre 2026 à mars 2027
fr.summary: L’analyse IPC estime que 1,19 million de personnes dans 46 districts ont connu une insécurité alimentaire aiguë de niveau Crise ou pire entre juillet et septembre 2026. Ce nombre pourrait atteindre 1,84 million d’octobre 2026 à mars 2027. Les inondations, les dégâts causés par le cyclone, les déplacements liés au conflit, les prix élevés et les risques climatiques associés à El Niño figurent parmi les facteurs signalés.

ar.title: توقعات بتفاقم انعدام الأمن الغذائي في موزمبيق خلال موسم الشح من أكتوبر 2026 إلى مارس 2027
ar.summary: يقدّر تحليل التصنيف المرحلي المتكامل أن 1.19 مليون شخص في 46 مقاطعة واجهوا انعدام أمن غذائي حاداً بمستوى الأزمة أو أسوأ خلال يوليو–سبتمبر 2026، مع توقع ارتفاع العدد إلى 1.84 مليون بين أكتوبر 2026 ومارس 2027. وتشمل العوامل المذكورة الفيضانات وأضرار الإعصار والنزوح بسبب النزاع وارتفاع الأسعار والمخاطر المناخية المرتبطة بظاهرة النينيو.

pt.title: A insegurança alimentar em Moçambique deverá agravar-se na época de escassez, de outubro de 2026 a março de 2027
pt.summary: A análise IPC estima que 1,19 milhões de pessoas em 46 distritos enfrentaram insegurança alimentar aguda de nível Crise ou pior entre julho e setembro de 2026, prevendo-se que o número aumente para 1,84 milhões entre outubro de 2026 e março de 2027. Entre os factores apontados estão inundações, danos causados por ciclones, deslocações devido ao conflito, preços elevados e riscos climáticos associados ao El Niño.

sw.title: Uhaba wa chakula nchini Msumbiji unatarajiwa kuongezeka katika kipindi cha Oktoba 2026 hadi Machi 2027
sw.summary: Uchambuzi wa IPC unakadiria kuwa watu milioni 1.19 katika wilaya 46 walikabiliwa na uhaba mkubwa wa chakula wa kiwango cha Mgogoro au zaidi kati ya Julai na Septemba 2026; idadi hiyo inatarajiwa kufikia milioni 1.84 kuanzia Oktoba 2026 hadi Machi 2027. Sababu zilizotajwa ni pamoja na mafuriko, uharibifu wa kimbunga, kuhama kwa watu kutokana na migogoro, bei za juu na hatari za tabianchi zinazohusishwa na El Niño.
